# Parenting Plan Builder — parentingplan.help

> A free, collaborative tool that helps two separating parents build a parenting plan together — no account required to start.

Built by Chrysalis Works Ltd, the same UK company behind Canopy (a private family/co-parenting app). parentingplan.help guides each parent through 8 sections — schedule, handovers & school holidays, special occasions & travel, digital life & communication, childcare & family, education & health, decisions & money — plus a generated summary. Each parent writes their own proposals; the other reviews and revises until both agree, with AI guidance flagging gaps or conflicts along the way. Supports UK, Scotland, Ireland, US, Australia, Canada, and other jurisdictions, with locale-specific fields (e.g. US legal custody type, domestic travel provisions). The finished plan can be downloaded as a PDF. A small number of AI plan reviews are free; further reviews are a one-time £1.99 unlock.

## How it works
1. Parent A works through the 8 sections (no account needed)
2. Parent A saves and shares — logs in via a passwordless magic link, invite emailed to Parent B
3. Parent B reviews Parent A's proposals pre-filled in every step, updates anything they disagree with, submits their draft
4. Parents go back and forth through revisions until both agree
5. Download the agreed plan as a PDF
